{{Quote|May I present the Animal Instincts!|Preigo, inducing the act|<ref name="Bound for Rescue">{{TCW|Bound for Rescue}}</ref>}}
The '''Animal Instincts''' were an [[Acrobat/Legends|acrobatic]] traveling [[Circus/Legends|circus]] troupe devised by [[Petro/Legends|Petro]] and his fellow [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] as a means of infiltrating [[Hondo's complex/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's pirate outpost]] on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]]. By posing as members of [[Preigo's Traveling World of Wonder/Legends|Preigo's Traveling World of Wonder]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Initiates hoped to [[Rescue on Florrum/Legends|rescue]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] from the [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Ohnaka Gang]].
